claim: All power gauges and gauges O(r^h) fail.
For a regularly varying gauge of index h, positive finite total Hausdorff mass yields the normalized spherical conformal measure.
No scalar gauge gives globally uniform two-sided ball estimates across pole and parabolic centers.
Conformal parabolic tail exponents and invariant tower first moments are distinct; the actual invariant finiteness criterion is attributed.
Independent Pareto variables admit only zero or infinite normalized limsup under the stated deterministic normalizations.
Existence of an arbitrary scalar exact spherical Hausdorff gauge for the source elliptic conformal measure is not settled.
